name: Properties of metals and non metals

questions.q: Which physical property is characteristic of almost all metals at room temperature (except mercury)?
a: They are shiny solids with high melting points
They are poor conductors of electricity

questions.q: What term describes the ability of metals to be hammered or shaped into flat sheets without breaking?
How do non-metals generally behave when in solid form?
a: They are extremely ductile and shiny
They can be hammered into wires
They tend to be brittle and shatter when struck
They conduct electricity better than copper

questions.q: Which of the following physical characteristics is typical of transition metals?
a: High densities, high melting points, and strength

questions.q: Why do non-metals make poor thermal and electrical conductors?
a: They lack free moving electrons or ions to carry current or heat energy

questions.q: What is the physical state of most non-metals on the periodic table at room temperature?
a: Mostly gases or low-melting point solids (with one liquid)
